text:
Maya (CS): Averon day0 check-in — quick rundown: two blocking items from today
Maya (CS): 1) Peering not propagating to their route tables (we see traffic flowing but no return).
Maya (CS): 2) KMS: their cloud-agent role gets AccessDenied on decrypt during key rotation test.
Maya (CS): Also customer asked about data residency + SLA language — flagged as medium renewal risk if not addressed by end of week.
Leo (NetEng): copying VPC IDs now, can you drop vpc-089a and their peer-id? I want to confirm route table tags.
Maya (CS): vpc-089a and peer-aws-averon-1 posted in the ticket, plus a pcap from their infra team.
Leo (NetEng): quick hypothesis: their route propagation is disabled on the transit GW attachment. Usually toggled on by the infra team in their account. Can we get IAM owner to flip?
Priya (Security): for KMS, most likely missing kms:Decrypt in the role trust or missing kms:ViaService condition. I'll propose a minimal policy — please confirm with their security team before applying:
Priya (Security): ```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{
    "Effect": "Allow",
    "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/cloud-agent"},
    "Action": ["kms:Decrypt", "kms:GenerateDataKey"],
    "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:987654321098:key/abcd-ef01"
  }]
}
```
Riley (Solutions): I can run through the preflight checklist with Averon on a 30-min call — suggest tomorrow 10am PT. I can also walk them through our enablement doc and collect feedback items for product.
Maya (CS): please do — customer's CSM (Amir) wants the enablement session recorded and a written checklist. Also ping legal for the SLA/data residency blurb.
Onboard-bot: [deploy] privnet-provisioning: attachment vpc-089a -> peer-aws-averon-1 created by leo-neteng at 4301234575
Leo (NetEng): I toggled propagation on the TGW attachment in their account and pushed a refresh. Route table now shows propagated routes for 10.2.0.0/16 -> next hop tgw-0abc.
Leo (NetEng): output from their route table check:
```
RouteTable: rtb-07a2
PropagatedRoutes:
 - 10.2.0.0/16 via tgw-0abc (state: active)
```
Priya (Security): I gave them the minimal KMS policy and asked security lead to attest. They confirmed adding kms:Decrypt to the cloud-agent role is in progress. I also validated that CloudTrail is configured to log KMS events to their logging S3.
Priya (Security): sample audit line from our tailing tool: `2026-03-20T17:11:02Z KMS Decrypt request keyId=abcd-ef01 principal=arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/cloud-agent status=AccessDenied` — will flip to Success once role updated.
Maya (CS): status update for renewal risk: customer appreciated the fast turnaround but wants written confirmation on residency + SLA before Friday. Riley, can you include that in the enablement doc and pass to legal?
Riley (Solutions): yep will add a short appendix with residency language and link to their region nodes. I'll also record the session and attach notes to the ticket.
Maya (CS): action owners:
 - Leo: confirm TGW propagation stable and post verification (ETA: 2 hours)
 - Priya: confirm KMS policy rollout and that CloudTrail shows success (ETA: 4 hours)
 - Riley: run enablement + capture feedback, add residency annex (ETA: 24 hours)
Maya (CS): tagging @here for visibility — if any blocker remains, escalate to eng-sre. :eyes: :thumbsup:
Onboard-bot: [reminder] follow-up: Averon enablement recording due in 24h
Leo (NetEng): propagation stable, verified at 4301234582, no flaps seen. :white_check_mark:
Priya (Security): KMS policy rolled by their sec-admin at 4301234588, I see Decrypt Success in CloudTrail after apply.
Maya (CS): great — closing blockers for day0. Riley, please paste the recording link and final checklist in the ticket when done. I'll mark renewal risk as "watch" and follow up with account exec.
Riley (Solutions): will do. thanks team. :handshake:
